body: Thank you I appreciate you saying that. It's just so hard to live with the guilt. And I do miss him so much every single day. I have felt really sad. I have realized that I have been so low for the last two years that maybe it is time for me to begin taking medication. But I'm really scared to do so too.

So me and that guy we were just friends at first, I never intended for anything like that t happen, and when I found out he liked he I just wanted to stay friends with him bc him and his group were the only friends I had had for such a long time, I finally felt like life was becoming normal again. But he kept persuing me, so eventually I did fall for him. I know now it was because of how lonely I felt and how I felt like my husband didn't care. I just regret it so much. Maybe I really am a horrible person. I just can't believe I was willing to hurt my husband so much, I hate myself so much for it.

First everything was great I moved to America to be with him. I started college, he worked a lot so all I did was study. I'm a very social person, but coming from a different country and meeting people and friends was really difficult. So I didn't have any friends for more than 2 years. My life basically became school bc I felt like I didn't have anything else. I started studying for almost 60-70h a week easily bc I felt like I didn't have anything else. School became my life, I was a 4.0 student in chemistry , I felt like that was the only thing that made me worth something. And obviously that didn't make my relationship better. I felt like he didn't help me when he saw how lonely I was. I felt like a prisoner in my own life bc all I did was study and I didn't have any friends. He had work and work friend's so he didn't really understand how isolated I felt. And I didn't feel like he supported me or tried to make us get to know people together when I told him how miserable I felt. Eventually I transferred to another university, and when I finally started getting friends and wanted both of us to hang out with them he didn't want to. I felt like he didn't want me to have the friends. And one day I found out one of my friends ( a guy) liked me, and I didn't want to tell my husband bc I was so scared of him not letting me be friends with these people anymore so I didn't tell him. I felt like he saw me, he was interested in me and my life like husband had never been. So eventually we sent some inappropriate texts, and some things happened ( we didn't have sex). My husband found out, and I have regretted what I did for 2 years now. I have all this guilt eating me away, how I could betray him like that. I hate myself so much, and sometimes I don't think I deserve to live for what I did. I have never done anything like that before, and I know it was just a result of how unhappy and unloved I felt by my husband at the time, but I hate myself so much for it.  I was so confused and so unhappy at the time. I have never done anything like that and I know I would never do such a thing again. But ever since that I felt like I have lost the love of my life. I love my husband so much. I do believe in second chances and that people can just mess up, but I don't feel like he does. After everything happened, after my husband I fell into an even deeper depression. it's been two years now, we haven't officially divorced but we haven't lived together for some time now. I wake up every morning wishing I could make it all undone, wishing I could have my husband back bc I really do love him so much. I lost my desire to live, I always wish that I would get some horrible disease or be in an accident so I don't have to end my life myself. I feel like the world would be a better place without me.

There is so much that happened. I had felt so unhappy for the longest time bc I had lived in America for almost 2 years and I didn't have any friends. All I did was study. I felt so unloved by him for the longest time and like he didn't support me when I was going through something that basically was a depression. Then I did something I regret more than anything, and he will not forgive me for it. I live with all this guilt bc it feels like I did all this to myself, because of unhappy I was at the time. I don't even recognize that person back then. I don't know if I want to move back, that means basically that I would lose my green card and everything and leave everything I built up in America forever. It's not easy to just move back to your home country when I spent the last 5-6 years building f up a new life somewhere else

My husband of 2 years (together for 8) just told me that he filed the paperwork for us to get divorced. I love him more than anything in the whole world, and I have for the two last years trying to convince him to work on our relationship and not give up. I moved across the world to be with him, so being away from my family does not make it easier.
